title: Glenmore Brown - Away with The Bad Forward the Good

lines.l: In our meditation, nothing impossible, in our sight, might never be tried, remember God been good to all our families, this world incredible, you and me.
You've been so good, and as you and me, in this command we can carry on,
but I'm away with the pain, forward the good, in all of the world, forward the good.
Please your soul, let goodness show, in all you do, let God control.
Frost-changed faces, every day we see, death was meant to be.
And oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
